newsitem.title: USA: Corn fiber oil found to cut cholesterol.
newsitem.headline: Corn fiber oil found to cut cholesterol.

text.p: Corn husks, currently used as a low-cost ingredient in cattle feed, contain oils that have been found to cut cholesterol levels in humans, researchers said Wednesday.

"What's been found with this oil is it has potentially much higher concentrations of cholesterol-lowering ingredients compared to normal vegetable oils that most of us consume when we try to replace saturated fats in our diet," University of Massachusetts biochemist Robert Nicolosi said.

Corn fiber oil has 20 times the amount of micronutrients that inhibit the body's bloodstream from absorbing cholesterol than corn oil, made from the germ of corn kernals, and other types of vegetable oils, he said.

Preliminary studies by researchers at the University of Massachusetts at Lowell indicate that corn fiber oil significantly lowered the amount of serum cholesterol and LDL cholesterol, the bad artery-clogging kind of cholesterol, in hamsters. University of Massachusetts and the U.S. Department of Agriculture have developed a patented process to extract the oil from corn.

Monsanto Co. said Wednesday it signed a licensing agreement to develop cholesterol-lowering food products made from the oil of corn husks and fiber. Nicolosi said research into processing corn fiber oil will continue, and products could reach the market as soon as two years.

Charlie Hough, a business development director with Monsanto, said the company may explore a variety of applications for the product. But the primary application will probably be as a food additive or as an alternative cooking oil, he said.
"I think we're seeing this as a potential food product primarily," he said.
Consumers fighting to keep their cholesterol levels down could potentially use foods with corn fiber oil in conjunction with popular cholesterol-fighting drugs on the market, he said.
Monsanto stock slipped 37.5 cents to $49.81 in consolidated afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
